verdict.rationale: LocalAI's marketing lists 'vision' among supported modalities alongside text, voice, images, video, 3D, and agents, implying vision-language model support, but no evidence pack item details a vision-specific API, image-input example, or a named VLM (e.g., llava) being run. missing for 10: dedicated vision/multimodal API docs, example of loading a vision-language model, sample image+text request, independent confirmation of working image understanding.
